name: The Education University of Hong Kong
summary: Tai Po university known for teacher education; five of its non-teaching degrees are taught in English and open to non-local applicants.

ib.text: The IB Diploma is accepted; English A grade 4, or English B grade 4 at HL or 5 at SL. Chinese grade 4 is also asked, with a case-by-case waiver for English-medium programmes. No points minimum is set.

programmes.name: Psychology
programmes.about: A psychology degree with a foundation, core and elective structure, areas of concentration and an internship; qualifying graduates can apply for membership of the Hong Kong Psychological Society.
programmes.ib: General requirements only. All major courses are taught in English; Cantonese or Putonghua may be used in General Education and electives.

needs.note: English B: grade 4 at HL or 5 at SL

programmes.selectionNote: Applications are read on a rolling basis, so apply as early as you can; shortlisted applicants are interviewed.

programmes.name: AI and Educational Technology
programmes.about: A four-year degree on artificial intelligence and its use in education and other industries, offered by the Department of Mathematics and Information Technology and mainly taught in English.
programmes.ib: General requirements only: English A grade 4, or English B grade 4 at HL or 5 at SL.

needs.note: English B: grade 4 at HL or 5 at SL

programmes.selectionNote: Applications are read on a rolling basis, so apply as early as you can; shortlisted applicants are interviewed.

programmes.name: Integrated Environmental Management
programmes.about: A multidisciplinary degree on environmental management and sustainability: management systems, risk and impact assessment, pollution control and environmental regulation. All major courses are taught in English.
programmes.ib: General requirements only: English A grade 4, or English B grade 4 at HL or 5 at SL.

needs.note: English B: grade 4 at HL or 5 at SL

programmes.selectionNote: Applications are read on a rolling basis, so apply as early as you can; shortlisted applicants are interviewed.

programmes.name: Personal Finance
programmes.about: A degree focused on personal financial advising and wealth management, covering taxation, credit management, retirement and estate planning, plus fintech, risk management and sustainable finance. Taught in English.
programmes.ib: General requirements only: English A grade 4, or English B grade 4 at HL or 5 at SL.

needs.note: English B: grade 4 at HL or 5 at SL

programmes.selectionNote: Applications are read on a rolling basis, so apply as early as you can; shortlisted applicants are interviewed.

programmes.name: Special Education
programmes.about: A degree for students who want to support people with special needs, leading to careers in education and human services. The programme is mainly conducted in English.
programmes.ib: General requirements only: English A grade 4, or English B grade 4 at HL or 5 at SL.

needs.note: English B: grade 4 at HL or 5 at SL

programmes.selectionNote: Applications are read on a rolling basis, so apply as early as you can; shortlisted applicants are interviewed.

notes: Hong Kong sets no EU rate: tuition for non-local undergraduates is HK$210,000 a year in 2027/28, marked provisional by EdUHK.
Not listed: Digital Chinese Culture and Heritage Education (taught in Chinese) and degrees where EdUHK states no teaching language, such as Sports Science; ask admissions before applying.
Each non-local applicant can list at most two programmes and pays an application fee of HK$300.
